description: This Java class extends Android's ImageView to add features for downloading, decoding, and displaying images from a URL, with caching and view management.

classes.name: PhotoView
classes.description: A custom ImageView subclass that supports image downloading from URLs, caching, and view management for Android applications.

methods.name: PhotoView
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the PhotoView with different parameters.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves custom attributes related to view visibility management.

methods.name: showView
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the associated sibling view.

methods.name: clearImage
methods.description: Clears the current image and makes the view visible.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the image.

methods.name: onAttachedToWindow
methods.description: Handles view attachment, setting up weak references to sibling views.

methods.name: onDetachedFromWindow
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the view is detached, preventing memory leaks.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Initiates image download if not already drawn and URL is set.

methods.name: setHideView
methods.description: Sets the weak reference to a sibling view for visibility control.

methods.name: setImageDrawable
methods.description: Sets the drawable and updates view visibility accordingly.

methods.name: setImageURL
methods.description: Sets the image URL, manages ongoing downloads, and initiates new download if needed.

methods.name: setStatusDrawable
methods.description: Sets a drawable if the view is empty.

methods.name: setStatusResource
methods.description: Sets a resource drawable if the view is empty.
